analysis.reason:
직전 3거래일 연속 관망 유지 후 금일 매수 전환.
RSI 33.0→42.4로 과매도 구간 탈출 확인.
MACD 히스토그램 -6.7684→-3.6078 개선세 확인.
5일 고가 $106.13, 5일 저가 $80.22로 Higher Low 패턴 초입 진입.
주봉 RSI 45.1, 주봉 MACD 히스토그램 -8.3018로 여전히 약세 구간이나, 일봉상 단기 반등 신호 포착.
ADX 27.2로 뚜렷한 추세 형성 중이나, -DI(36.3)가 +DI(21.3)보다 우위인 점은 경계 필요.
ATR 12.43 대비 손절폭 1.3배 설정.
analysis.reasonEn:
Shifted to buy from a 3-day consecutive wait-and-see stance.
RSI confirmed exit from oversold at 33.0 → 42.4.
MACD histogram shows improvement from -6.7684 → -3.6078.
Price pattern shows the beginning of a Higher Low with 5-day high $106.13 and low $80.22.
Weekly RSI at 45.1 and MACD histogram at -8.3018 indicate a bearish zone, but short-term bullish signals are present on the daily chart.
ADX at 27.2 suggests a clear trend, but the -DI (36.3) being stronger than +DI (21.3) warrants caution.
Stop loss set at 1.3x ATR ($12.43).

· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): Short-term rebound timing, expectation of further upside on breaking initial resistance.
